semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company supports semiconductor-related projects through technology transfer and startup support, but is not a direct supplier of semiconductor products.
summary: Inovační centrum Ústeckého kraje, z.s. (ICUK) facilitates technology transfer and supports startups in Northern Bohemia, particularly in semiconductor-related projects. As part of the Czech National Semiconductor Cluster, it integrates into the Saxon innovation ecosystem, offering consulting services and educational programs to foster innovation and business expansion.

regional_presence.Europe: ICUK is integrated into the Saxon innovation ecosystem, leveraging regional expertise in industrial chemistry and recycling technologies.
